title: Offline net2 trained as neto2 was: TD3+BC on net1 v7 and net1 v9, reading distributions or means, three seeds
description: exp-neto2-search2-val-247 scored the learned neto2 (expliCCit's memoryless actor trained offline on neto1's values) at +0.024 to +0.065 above BBRv3 on validation links for TD3+BC, with the rule at +0.136 to +0.147. No net2 has had the same training. This run trains the same actor with the same data (exp-data-net2-steps-222), split, reward, action and seeds 0 to 2 on our net1s instead: net1 v7 (7 LCFs, exp-net1v6-229) and net1 v9 (27 LCFs, exp-net1v9-243), each release's chosen run. The arms are the two TD3+BC settings that did best for neto2 (alpha 5 and alpha 10 at 200000 steps, experiments/specs/net2/offline-search2.json). The actor reads either each LCF's distribution summed into 16 bins (view bins16) or the means only (view means); the means arm is the closest match to neto2's input. So the learner is held fixed and only the estimator and what it hands over change. This release holds training diagnostics; the closed-loop comparison with neto2 follows in its own run. No claim before that and before tuning.
run: N="$IN/$NET1/$(cat "$IN/$NET1/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; O="$OUT/net2-$NET1-$VIEW-$ARM-s$SEED"; mkdir -p "$O"; if [ "$VIEW" = means ]; then V='{"view": "means"}'; else V='{"view": "bins", "input_bins": 16}'; fi; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --arg arm "$ARM" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson v "$V" --slurpfile a experiments/specs/net2/offline-search2.json '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, net2: ($a[0][$arm] + $v)}' > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"
collect: { echo "| arm | transitions | actions clipped | validation BC error | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/net2-*/report.json; do echo "| $(basename "$(dirname "$r")") | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.actions_clipped, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
